rules.title: Workspace Package Naming
rules.check: Workspace packages MUST use scoped names: @apps/{name} for applications, @packages/{name} for shared libraries.
rules.rationale: Scoped names prevent conflicts with npm packages and clearly distinguish internal packages.

rules.title: Path Aliases for Internal Packages
rules.check: tsconfig MUST define path aliases for internal packages.
rules.bad_example:
import { logger } from "../../../packages/logger/src";
import { utils } from "../../packages/utils/src/index";
rules.rationale: Path aliases enable clean imports without relative path gymnastics.

rules.title: Turbo Task Definition
rules.check: Monorepos using Turbo MUST define task dependencies and outputs in turbo.json.
rules.rationale: Proper task configuration enables caching and parallel execution.

rules.title: Shared Package Structure
rules.check: Shared packages MUST have consistent structure with src/, dist/, and proper exports.
rules.bad_example:
packages/logger/
├── index.ts        # Source at root
├── logger.ts
└── package.json    # No exports field
rules.good_example:
packages/logger/
├── src/
│   ├── index.ts
│   └── logger.ts
├── dist/           # Build output (gitignored)
├── package.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── README.md

rules.title: Engine Constraints
rules.check: Monorepos MUST specify Node and package manager version constraints.
rules.rationale: Prevents "works on my machine" issues and ensures consistent builds.
